issues.quote: Net income declined 52.7% to $6.4 billion in fiscal 2024 from $15.0 billion in fiscal 2023
issues.problem: Tesla's FY2024 GAAP net income attributable to common stockholders was about $7.1 billion, not $6.4 billion. The 52.7% decline from $15.0B only works with about $7.1B; $6.4B would mean a drop of about 57%.

data.summary: Revenue, gross profit, margins, operating income, R&D and EPS figures are correct. FY2024 net income is misstated as $6.4B; the actual figure is about $7.1B, which is what the stated 52.7% decline requires.
